title: Ubugingo bw'Umuyoboro
intro: Usubira mu gihe umutegetsi w’umugome yasabaga ko abantu biyegurira imana z’ibinyoma byimazeyo. Umuryango muto w’abantu biyeguriye Imana waranze, maze bahura n’igihano gikomeye cyane ku buryo cyahindutse umuvumo w’iteka ryose. Inkuru yabo iragaruka muri Korowani nk’igihamya cy’ukwizera kudacogora. Ese ushobora kumenya iri tsinda rihamye?
clues: Twabaga mu gihugu cyari kiri munsi y'ubutegetsi bw'igitugu bwasabaga ko dusenga imana z'ibinyoma
Umuryango wacu wahuye n'ibitotezo bikomeye kubera ukwemera kwacu muri Allah gusa
Umutegetsi yategetse ko hacukurwa umuyoboro munini kandi ugatwikwa n'inkongi z'umuriro
Kubera ko twanze kwihakana ukwizera kwacu, twajugunywe muri urwo rwobo rugurumana umwe umwe
Inkuru yacu yabaye igice cya Korowani, kandi abadutotezaga baravumwe iteka ryose
Sura yanditse amakuba yacu yitiriwe ibimenyetso bikomeye byo mu kirere

trial.label: Igeragezwa ryacu
options: Gutwikwa ari muzima mu rwobo rw'umuriro
trial.answer: Gutwikwa ari muzima mu rwobo rw'umuriro

options: Inkingi ndende z'umujyi wa kera wari waraciriweho iteka ryose
Inzu zo mu misozi zishushanyije mu bitare by'amabuye

options: Twarishwe kandi abadutotezaga baravumwe iteka ryose
Induru imwe y'agahinda yashenye ubuzima bwacu
outcome.answer: Twarishwe kandi abadutotezaga baravumwe iteka ryose

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
